main.description: List the requester's private audiences, newest first (by record key), with their members. Only the requester's own: no method gives anyone else an audience's members or their number. A page also ends early, with a cursor, once its audiences hold 20000 members together; it always holds at least one. Requires auth by a community member, whether or not its indexing is ready.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
Present when more of the requester's audiences may follow.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: limit is out of range, or cursor is malformed.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

cid.description: An opaque version token for updateAudience's swapCid, not a CID.

record.description: The tools.kryphocron.policy.audience record: $type, mode (absent when none), name (absent when none), members, createdAt, updatedAt.
